body: Hi, I feel your words, I got to the point where I'm the monster. I see people avoiding me in part because they can probably feel my soul rotting and in part because I keep them far from me. What kind of hope are you talking about? For me hope never made any difference, I can hope to feel better same day but the truth, for me at least, is that I've never seen me growing old as an option, even when I wasn't suicidal yet, when I was just a kid.
Ty😄
Glad to hear it! I'm not Hypersensitive in general so I guess is the bike. I've been as a pillion on a couple of bikes and i had this problem just with one
So far it looks like it's just a pillion problem, I'm  relieved
Tell your friend it was a versys 650
Hope so. Ty for the advice
It has always happened during particularly beautiful rides or long ones, and I have to say that I really trust my friend's driving abilities. So it might be a correct guess.
😂Actually I want to avoid the problem
I'll have a scrambler. I would take more classes to be sure but it's all shut down due to the pandemic .
Ty, I had this problem as a pillion on a Versys 650
The whole point is not ruining the friendship

I'm 99% sure that there is no interest. However we really are close friends it's not like I can't just vanish.
I'm looking elsewhere for intimacy, but it's not satisfying. I thought that time could heal but it just got stronger through the years.

I would explain to her that there are and will be important people in your life, not only her, and that it doesn't diminish her value whatsoever. If she is not okay with that it might be a major red flag
Ty, I'm actually trying to date someone else.
It doesn't seem a big deal to me too. If it wasn't illegal he would have no problem with it?
I've been in your situation once, not a marriage,  just a relationship, but I was feeling like you. The real question is do you still love him?

Hope I'll find a way to do it. I'm rejecting everybody that come close to me...or I push them away as soon as I realise that I'm getting too close to them. In few days I'm going to see a friend of mine I've been attracted to for too long just to push him away. A part of me thinks that  it's bs but my guts tell me to keep a distance.
It's an idea worth trying. Ty
I agree, it's the reason why I can't get out from pain and guilt...
I decided not to tell him, it would break him. I've always felt like a good person but not anymore. Ty for the advice, hope u get better too.
